data.desc: Lantern Pharma (NASDAQ: LTRN) is an AI-driven company transforming the cost, pace, and timeline of oncology drug discovery and development. Our proprietary AI and machine learning platform, RADR, leverages over 200 billion oncology-focused data points and a library of 200+ advanced ML algorithms to help solve billion-dollar, real-world problems in oncology drug development, with the aim of generating oncology medicines at dramatically reduced costs and accelerated timelines. Our lead development programs include a Phase 2 clinical program in never-smoker and non-smoker NSCLC, planned Phase 1b/2 trials in biomarker-defined solid tumors, and an ongoing Phase 1 program in hematologic malignancies and adult soft tissue sarcomas.
